strings.zh: ……　……　……{SCROLL}……　……　……{SCROLL}……　……　……{SCROLL}……　……明白了！{SCROLL}你想要这个啊！{SCROLL}
strings.en: ...{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}...I got it!{SCROLL}You wanted this!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: ……你明白的吧？{NEWLINE}技能机２９是精神干扰,{SCROLL}……顺利的话{NEWLINE}还可以降低对方的特防！
strings.en: ...You understand, don’t you? TM29 is{NEWLINE}Psychic.{SCROLL}...With luck, it can lower the target’s{NEWLINE}Sp. Def too!

strings.zh: 哇！居然有训练家被传送过来了？{NEWLINE}我好久都没有见到{CLEAR}现实世界的训练家了呢。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Whoa! A Trainer got teleported here? I{NEWLINE}haven’t seen a Trainer from the real{CLEAR}world in ages.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这里是哪里？
strings.en: Where is this?

strings.zh: 你是谁？
strings.en: Who are you?

strings.zh: 我该怎么离开这里？
strings.en: How do I get out of here?

strings.zh: 没事,打扰了。
strings.en: Never mind, sorry to bother you.

strings.zh: 你进来的时候{NEWLINE}娜姿没有跟你说吗？{CLEAR}这里是她创造的异空间啊,{CLEAR}就按照金黄市的样子{CLEAR}做了一个一模一样的异空间。
strings.en: Didn’t Sabrina tell you when you came{NEWLINE}in? This is a pocket dimension she{CLEAR}created. She made it an exact copy of{CLEAR}Saffron City.

strings.zh: 我既是娜姿也不是娜姿,{NEWLINE}我是这个异空间的管理员。
strings.en: I am Sabrina, and yet I am not Sabrina.{NEWLINE}I’m the caretaker of this pocket{CLEAR}dimension.

strings.zh: 这个简单,{NEWLINE}你要是想离开的话,{CLEAR}我把你传送走就是了。{CLEAR}那么,你现在想回到金黄市吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: That’s easy. If you want to leave, I’ll{NEWLINE}just teleport you out. So, do you want{CLEAR}to go back to Saffron City now?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 好嘞,走你！
strings.en: Okay, off you go!

strings.zh: 娜姿『你现在知道{NEWLINE}我们的差距了吧？{CLEAR}如果你的意志力不够{CLEAR}就会被超能力影响,{CLEAR}凭现在的你是无法打败我的。
strings.en: Sabrina: Now do you understand the gap{NEWLINE}between us? If your will isn’t strong{CLEAR}enough, psychic powers will sway you. As{CLEAR}you are now, you cannot defeat me.

strings.zh: 娜姿『不过超能力也有它的弱点,{NEWLINE}比如幽灵系的精灵和技能{CLEAR}就对超能力非常不利。{CLEAR}为了克服这个弱点,{CLEAR}我现在要去紫苑镇的精灵之塔修行。{CLEAR}等你哪天锻炼得足够强大时,{CLEAR}再来找我挑战吧。
strings.en: Sabrina: But psychic powers have their{NEWLINE}weaknesses too. Ghost-type Pokémon{CLEAR}and moves, for instance, are very bad{CLEAR}for them. To overcome that weakness, I{CLEAR}am going to train at the Pokémon Tower{CLEAR}in Lavender Town. When you have trained{CLEAR}enough to be truly strong, come{CLEAR}challenge me.

strings.zh: 我可是能{NEWLINE}直击口袋妖怪内心的超能力者。{SCROLL}精灵在成长过程中{NEWLINE}记住后又忘掉的技能,{CLEAR}我能通过唤醒记忆的方式{CLEAR}让它们重新被记起。{SCROLL}但是我也不白干,{SCROLL}给我一枚心之鳞片的话,{NEWLINE}我就帮你想起一个技能！{SCROLL}那么需要帮你的精灵{NEWLINE}重新记起技能吗？
strings.en: I’m a psychic who can see straight into{NEWLINE}a Pokémon’s heart.{SCROLL}When Pokémon grow, they learn moves{NEWLINE}and then forget them. By awakening{CLEAR}their memories, I can make them{CLEAR}remember those moves again.{SCROLL}But I don’t work for free.{SCROLL}Give me one Heart Scale, and I’ll help{NEWLINE}your Pokémon remember one move!{SCROLL}So, do you want me to help your Pokémon{NEWLINE}remember a move?

strings.zh: 需要的话欢迎再来找我。
strings.en: If you need me, come back anytime.

strings.zh: 想要回忆技能的话,{NEWLINE}就拿来心之鳞片吧！
strings.en: If you want a Pokémon to remember a{NEWLINE}move, bring me a Heart Scale!

strings.zh: 唔……{SCROLL}想让蛋回忆起技能？{NEWLINE}这个不太可能吧？{SCROLL}它还没出生呢！
strings.en: Hmm...{SCROLL}You want an Egg to remember a move?{NEWLINE}That’s not really possible, is it?{SCROLL}It hasn’t even hatched yet!

strings.zh: 抱歉……{SCROLL}没有可以让这只精灵{NEWLINE}回忆起的技能。
strings.en: Sorry...{SCROLL}There are no moves this Pokémon can{NEWLINE}remember.

strings.zh: 要回忆起哪个技能？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Which move should it remember?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:3}作为谢礼{NEWLINE}送出了一枚心之鳞片！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:3} handed over a Heart Scale as{NEWLINE}thanks!

strings.zh: 娜姿都跟我说了,{NEWLINE}现在金黄市出事了对吧？{CLEAR}娜姿她可是个很自负的人,{CLEAR}她愿意耗尽体力把你传送进来,{CLEAR}说明她很看好你的实力哦。{SCROLL}在把你传送进金黄市之前,{NEWLINE}娜姿叮嘱我把这个交给你。
strings.en: Sabrina told me everything. Something’s{NEWLINE}happened in Saffron City, right? Sabrina{CLEAR}is a very proud person. If she’s willing{CLEAR}to wear herself out teleporting you in,{CLEAR}she must think very highly of your{CLEAR}abilities.{SCROLL}Before teleporting you into Saffron{NEWLINE}City, Sabrina told me to give you this.
Hnn... Hyaah...!

strings.zh: 呀呀呀呀……！
strings.en: Hyah-yah-yah-yah...!

strings.zh: 啊啊啊啊！
strings.en: Aaaaaah!

strings.zh: 好嘞,走……
strings.en: Okay, off you...

strings.zh: 哇,你的意志力好强啊,{NEWLINE}我的超能力刚刚被弹回来了。{CLEAR}现在娜姿都已经能把你样的人{CLEAR}给传送进来了吗？{SCROLL}把你传送出去可不是一件容易的事,{NEWLINE}你放松精神不要想事情,{CLEAR}这样能稍微减弱一些对超能力的抵抗。
strings.en: Whoa, your will is so strong! My psychic{NEWLINE}power just bounced right off you. Can{CLEAR}Sabrina teleport people like you in now?{SCROLL}Teleporting you out isn’t easy. Relax{NEWLINE}your mind and don’t think about{CLEAR}anything. That will weaken your{CLEAR}resistance to psychic power a little.

strings.zh: 娜姿『你已经感受到{NEWLINE}超能力的强大了吧？{CLEAR}凭你现在的意志力{CLEAR}距离完全抵抗住我的超能力,{CLEAR}还有一点点差距。{SCROLL}娜姿『正好我现在要去{NEWLINE}紫苑镇的精灵之塔修行。{CLEAR}你如果也想锻炼一下自己的意志力,{CLEAR}就来精灵之塔找我吧。
strings.en: Sabrina: You have felt how powerful{NEWLINE}psychic power is, have you not? With the{CLEAR}will you have now, you are still a little{CLEAR}short of fully resisting my powers.{SCROLL}Sabrina: As it happens, I am about to go{NEWLINE}train at the Pokémon Tower in Lavender{CLEAR}Town. If you also wish to train your{CLEAR}will, come find me at the Pokémon Tower.

strings.zh: 在把你传送进金黄市之前,{NEWLINE}娜姿叮嘱我把这个交给你。
strings.en: Before teleporting you into Saffron{NEWLINE}City, Sabrina told me to give you this.

strings.zh: 这是娜姿耗费一年时间,{NEWLINE}用超能力制造出来的替身玩偶。{CLEAR}遇到危急时刻你把玩偶扔出去,{CLEAR}玩偶落地的瞬间,你和你的精灵{CLEAR}与玩偶之间的位置会互换。{CLEAR}这是只能使用一次的保命道具,{CLEAR}使用的时机你自己要考虑好。{SCROLL}需要叮嘱你的就这么多,{NEWLINE}我现在就把你传送回金黄道馆。{CLEAR}你放松精神不要想事情,{CLEAR}不然我可传送不动你。
strings.en: This is a Substitute Doll that Sabrina{NEWLINE}spent a whole year making with her{CLEAR}psychic powers. In a pinch, throw the{CLEAR}doll. The moment it hits the ground, you{CLEAR}and your Pokémon swap places with it.{CLEAR}It’s a lifesaver that can only be used{CLEAR}once, so think carefully about when{CLEAR}to use it.{SCROLL}That’s all I need to tell you. I’ll{NEWLINE}teleport you back to the Saffron Gym{CLEAR}now. Relax your mind and don’t think{CLEAR}about anything, or I won’t be able to{CLEAR}move you.
strings.notes: | RV027: meaning: one-use lifesaver; removed invented causal link

strings.zh: 一个可爱的玩偶娃娃。
strings.en: A cute little doll.
